mapper.select:
SELECT T.* FROM T_CORE_TABLE T
ORDER BY
T.ID

SELECT T.* FROM (SELECT UPPER(C.TABLE_NAME) TABLENAME, UPPER(C.COLUMN_NAME) FIELDNAME, UPPER(C.DATA_TYPE) FIELDTYPE, CASE UPPER(C.DATA_TYPE) WHEN 'VARCHAR' THEN C.CHARACTER_MAXIMUM_LENGTH ELSE '' END FIELDLENGTH, IF(UPPER(C.IS_NULLABLE) = 'YES', '1', '0') ALLOWNULL, IFNULL(C.COLUMN_COMMENT, '') FIELDCOMMENT, REPLACE(IFNULL(C.COLUMN_DEFAULT, ''), '''', '') DEFAULTVALUE, C.NUMERIC_PRECISION `PRECISION`, C.NUMERIC_SCALE SCALE FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS C WHERE C.TABLE_SCHEMA = DATABASE() ORDER BY C.ORDINAL_POSITION) T
